AGENT_INFEASIBLE: .github/workflows/ci.yaml

The issue's whole deliverable is the CI workflow, and `.agents/fix.yaml` bans `.github/**` for this worker class: CI runs `on: pull_request`, so an edit there executes my branch's code on the runner before a human looks. Ending without pushing.

AGENT_ERROR: anomaly latch — two live verdicts at the same head

A human: inspect the review thread, then remove the `agent/error` label to resume.
